title: An Angel in the Temple
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: Long ago lived a good old man named Zacharias. He and his wife, Elisabeth, had no children.
One day Zacharias went into the temple, Heavenly Father’s holy house. He burned sweet-smelling incense while the people prayed outside. An angel stood by the altar!
Zacharias shook with fear. The angel said, “Fear not. Your prayer is heard. Elisabeth will have a baby boy named John.”
p2: “How can I know this? We are so old,” said Zacharias. The angel said, “I am Gabriel. You did not believe me, so you cannot talk until the baby comes.” Zacharias came out and could only wave his hands.
Heavenly Father hears every prayer, even ones we pray for a long time. Tonight, tell Him something you have been asking for.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
